name: Limewired

evidence.note: Band site: high-energy 80s, 90s and 2000s covers; calls a show a traveling party for all ages.
Flanagan's Pub, Ronkonkoma: Oktoberfest Oct 4 in the back lot with Limewired from 2 PM.
Band calendar also lists 89 North and Daisy's Nashville Lounge shows.

dancing.notes: A party cover band that calls its shows a 'traveling party'. Its Oct 4 gig is a family-friendly outdoor Oktoberfest.

description: A Long Island cover band playing rock and pop hits from the 80s, 90s and 2000s at bars, breweries and outdoor festivals.
reviewNotes:
Added from Ira's List research (2026-10-03). Instagram link comes from the band site; not opened. No crowd video watched.

Directory research 2026-10-04: Facebook: the band site links the numeric page facebook.com/184550338866502; search results show the same page as facebook.com/LimeWiredBand (Smithtown, NY). Instagram: the band site links instagram.com/LimeWired, but that handle appears to belong to a touring "LimeWired - Ultimate 2000s Party" brand (linktr.ee/Limewired); the Salt Shack and Boat Yard artist pages (band-supplied text) link instagram.com/limewiredlive instead, so we recorded limewiredlive (Instagram could not be opened, HTTP 429) - please confirm. No YouTube/TikTok links found (the venue pages' YouTube/TikTok buttons point to Facebook). Contact is via a form on the home page; no booking email or phone published. No clean logo file: the site og:image is a collage of band photos around the lime logo, so it was not used as a logo. Current description is still accurate.

evidence.note: Band site calls Limewired a Long Island cover band playing 80s, 90s and 2000s hits and lists an Oct 4, 2026 Oktoberfest show at Flanagan's in Ronkonkoma.
Shows page lists Daisy's Nashville Lounge (Miller Place), 89 North (Patchogue) and other Patchogue dates in Oct-Nov 2026.

factsSource: Checked October 4, 2026. Sources: limewiredband.com, saltshackny.com, facebook.com.
